world_prompt.text_prompt: Build a continuous interior environment based closely on the supplied Screen06 reference. An enormous cylindrical washer-drum tunnel has glossy purple and magenta metal walls, orderly rows of rounded perforations, and substantial broad reflective gold circumferential bands. A glossy cyan waterslide with vivid pink edges winds around bends and descends deeply through the tunnel, extending from the foreground into the distance. Preserve the saturated candy-like lighting, enclosed tunnel depth, iridescent bubbles, and white foam along the slide. Form a spatially coherent explorable three-dimensional interior from a viewpoint on the descending slide. Environment only, without people, game characters, text, HUD, or interface elements. Preserve the reference's main structure and material palette.
